title: WAMTA keynote page data (keynote.yml)
description: Drives the per-year /keynote page rendered by _includes/keynote.md. Each talk has a structured speaker, title, and abstract; optional homepage and materials links are surfaced as clickable links and a bulleted list.

nav_hidden.description: When true, the page stays reachable but is omitted from the top navigation.

talks.description: Ordered list of keynote talks (typically labeled Keynote I, II, III). May be an empty array on placeholder years.

label.description: Section label rendered above the talk (e.g. 'Keynote I').

affiliation.description: Optional affiliation (institution / lab). Plain text only; do not embed markdown links here, use the homepage field instead.

homepage.description: Optional URL to the speaker's homepage. Rendered as a trailing clickable link after the affiliation.

abstract.description: Multi-paragraph abstract. Markdown allowed; do not embed structured material lists here, use 'materials' instead.

materials.description: Optional list of supplementary links (Slides, Video, ...).
